displayName: Polson — studio memory over 85% for 5 minutes

conditions.displayName: Memory utilization p99 over 85% for 5 min

documentation.content: The polson-studio service has used over 85% of its memory limit for 5 minutes. An alert only. At 4 GiB, measured peaks were about 1.3 GiB for a busy day of runs and 0.5 GiB for 1080p video work, so this means something has grown: two heavy runs at once, projects piling up on the instance (Cloud Run's disk is held in memory, so every file a run writes counts), or the vision venv (torch) loaded by face or pose detection. Past 100% Cloud Run restarts the instance and any run on it is lost. Check the request log and the projects on the instance; raise --memory if it is legitimate.
